items.title: What are we all playing this weekend?
items.zh_title: 这个周末大家都在玩什么？
items.summary: This is the last empty weekend before I go on holiday for a frankly indulgent three weeks. As such, it will likely be spent either remembering all the things my partner and I've not organised for the…

items.title: Mobile Game Gatekeepers Are Opening the Gates
items.zh_title: 手游守门人正在打开大门
items.summary: For years, two companies decided which mobile games players ever saw. That is starting to change, and it changes what your next launch can look like.
items.zh_summary: 多年来，两家公司决定了玩家能看到哪些手游。这一局面开始改变，而这会改变你下一次发行的样子。

items.title: SAG-AFTRA introduces new process for hiring union actors in game pitches
items.zh_title: SAG-AFTRA 推出新流程，方便游戏提案聘用工会演员
items.summary: SAG-AFTRA actors can now be recruited for vertical slices, demos, and other forms of content needed to pitch games.
items.zh_summary: SAG-AFTRA 的演员现在可以受聘参与 vertical slice、demo 以及提案所需的其他内容形式。

items.title: Report: Silver Lake and the Saudi Arabia PIF hold talks with Unity to explore acquisition
items.zh_title: 报道：Silver Lake 与沙特 PIF 正与 Unity 洽谈收购
items.summary: The investment partners recently acquired Electronic Arts and are now reportedly turning their gaze toward software engine Unity.
items.zh_summary: 这两家投资方最近收购了 Electronic Arts，如今据报道正把目光投向软件引擎 Unity。

items.title: Elections signal cultural shifts that no creative industry can dare to ignore | Opinion
items.zh_title: 选举释放的文化转向，没有哪个创意产业敢忽视 | 观点
items.summary: There is a perfectly logical way in which you can look at an election result – even a truly seismic election result – and say that it is largely irrelevant to the business decision-making of the games…
